edits.old: This model was fitted for the four nutritional traits and for flowering time, number of tillers, grain weight and spike length (Table 1, Fig. 1a). To visualize genotype-by-season interaction, reaction norms were drawn from the mean centered value of each accession in each season (Fig. 1b). For each nutritional trait, four accessions with values in all three seasons were highlighted, picked in turn and without repetition: the most stable (smallest sum of absolute changes between consecutive seasons), the strongest increase and the strongest decrease from 2019–20 to 2021–22, and the strongest crossover (the largest range among accessions whose direction of change reversed between seasons).
